name: scroll-area
title: Scroll Area
description: A compact scroll panel holding a heading and a long list of version numbers. Content scrolls under the fixed frame, with a slim themed bar on the right instead of the browser's own scrollbar.
use: A list is longer than its frame and you want a slim, themed bar instead of the browser scrollbar.
avoid: The thumb is only about ten pixels wide, so it is hard to grab and drag on a touch screen.
a11y: The list carries no label and the viewport has no visible focus style, so keyboard scrolling is not signposted. (keyboard: partial, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow bordered dark panel with a small heading and a list of grey version strings separated by faint rules, plus a thin lighter bar sitting just inside its right edge.
behaves: Wheel scrolling or dragging the slim bar moves the rows under the frame; the heading travels up with the content and disappears, and the rows pass out of sight at top and bottom.
customise: Any content goes in as children and the wrapper takes a height and width through className; bar width, thumb colour and corner are class overrides.
weight: light: One scrollable viewport with a styled thumb; no animation loop.
